_meta.description: Per-kind default config values (REQ-18/19/19b/21/39). Single source of truth is trainer/src/fandhe_edge_trainer/kinds/*.py::DEFAULT_CONFIG. Cross-checked by trainer/tests/test_kind_defaults_fixture.py (equality with each kind DEFAULT_CONFIG) and crates/train/src/result.rs (effective config = kind defaults overwritten by request.config, compared for full equality against the artifact config returned by the worker). Adding a new kind to the selection point (kinds/__init__.py::_registry) requires adding its DEFAULT_CONFIG here, or the Python fixture test fails.
